'''Conno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] five year old [[Ghostling]]. Along with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Arawynne]], he was captured by [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]] and brought to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to be sold as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], but was rescued by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
